import re
data = json.loads(input_json)

def format_time(seconds):
    h = int(seconds // 3600)
    m = int((seconds % 3600) // 60)
    s = int(seconds % 60)
    ms = int(round((seconds - int(seconds)) * 1000))
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d},{ms:03d}"

def split_sentences(text):
    text = text.strip()
    # 保护数字中间的小数点(如5.6、2.8),避免被误判为句子结束
    protected = re.sub(r'(\d)\.(\d)', r'\1<DOT>\2', text)
    parts = re.split(r'(?<=[。！？.!?])\s*', protected)
    parts = [p.replace('<DOT>', '.') for p in parts if p.strip()]
    return parts

blocks = []
idx = 1
for item in data:
    seg_start = item.get("start", 0)
    seg_end = item.get("end", 0)
    duration = max(seg_end - seg_start, 0.01)
    source = item.get("source", "").strip()
    target = item.get("target", "").strip()
    target = re.sub(r'\btarget', '', target, flags=re.IGNORECASE).strip()

    src_sentences = split_sentences(source)
    tgt_sentences = split_sentences(target)

    if len(src_sentences) != len(tgt_sentences) or len(src_sentences) <= 1:
        blocks.append(f"{idx}\n{format_time(seg_start)} --> {format_time(seg_end)}\n{target}\n{source}")
        idx += 1
        continue

    lengths = [len(s) for s in src_sentences]
    total_len = sum(lengths) or 1
    cursor = seg_start
    for i, (s_src, s_tgt, length) in enumerate(zip(src_sentences, tgt_sentences, lengths)):
        portion = duration * (length / total_len)
        s_start = cursor
        s_end = seg_end if i == len(src_sentences) - 1 else cursor + portion
        blocks.append(f"{idx}\n{format_time(s_start)} --> {format_time(s_end)}\n{s_tgt}\n{s_src}")
        idx += 1
        cursor = s_end

result = "\n\n".join(blocks)
